corrections: Replaced the generic stealth-fighter shape with a dedicated F-35A chine nose,hollow cockpit,diverterless intake bumps,open raked ducts,single spine,F135 circular exhaust,aligned wings,all-moving tails and canted fins.

Uniform exterior overlays corrected spine height,lower-body width,canopy profile,fin sweep and intake shoulder transitions. Used independently published tail span despite a slightly wider tail in the promotional three-view.

Rebuilt the20x8in panoramic display and its surround from JPO dimensions and the rectified public mock-up photo. Overlay lowered the coaming and raised the standby/keypad module. Added right side-stick,left single throttle,pedals,seat,harness and console ledges.

Close views found exposed internal lining at intake shoulders and gaps at the spine transition. Reconstructed the cowl around the lip and narrowed the internal throat. Added a full cockpit liner,footwell bulkhead and internal windshield bow;exterior lettering and optical housing no longer show through the cabin.

Main and standby attitude,heading,true airspeed,geometric altitude and vertical-speed readouts use shared derived variables. Missing data blanks live readings and negative altitude preserves its sign. Unsupported tactical,sensor,engine and fuel fields remain inactive.

Swept leading-flap,flaperon and rudder mounts keep hinge lines attached. Flaperons combine flap and roll expressions;differential stabilators,gear,stick,throttle and pedals animate. No weapons or external pylons.
independentDimensions: Manufacturer51.4ft=15.667m rounded length,35ft=10.668m wingspan,4.38m height,22.5ft=6.858m horizontal-tail span and42.7m2nominal wing area. SingaporeMINDEF provides an independent dimensions source.

The JPO promotional rendering is not dimensioned and shows gear retracted. Side length and front span set uniform scales;4.38m fin height sets the reconstructed grounddatum. Horizontal-tail width differs from the drawing;published span takes precedence without axis stretching.
Canopy length about2.95m andmaximumheight3.11m reconstructed from the three-view. Wheelbase6.25m,track2.56m,wheel sizes andretraction are approximations because that drawing has no deployed gear.

JPO20x8in panoramic display gives.508x.2032m active area. Four-corner perspective transform recorded for the public2010 mock-up. Only that display plane is calibrated;standby,consoledepths,seat andcontrolspacing remain photo-based approximations.
reviewNotes.visual: Compared the JPO three-view,USAFDonaldAllen upper-airframe photograph,Ahunt mock-up panel andJPOseat/canopy photo. Personally inspected all24 final-hash captures in six contact sheets:four exterior/panel overlays,eight standard views,andtwelve instrument/control/detail states. Final checks include clean gear-up flight,opposite control deflections,missing data,negative altitude,canopy,intake cowl andexhaust.
limitations: Polygonal interpretation,not an engineering replica. Promotional three-view predates production andcontains view-scale discrepancies;compound section curvature,intake internals,gear mechanics,access borders,fasteners,labels andlivery are simplified.

Cockpit panel uses a publicly identified2010 mock-up,not a verified production-block installation. Known display size anchors its main plane;console/standby depths,switch identities,seat upholstery andharness are approximate. JPO simulator image is not treated as an installed cockpit reference.

FLIGHT/SIM andSTANDBY/SIM are authored simulator presentations,not operational F-35 avionics. No radar,sensorfusion,tacticalmap,helmet display,pressure altitude,magnetic heading orcalibrated IAS/Mach. Engine/fuel readings remain unavailable.

Shared assisted physics andsimplified controlmixes are not the F-35 flight-control laws. Fixed neutral exhaust,approximate landing-gear movement with hiding behind closed bays,static canopy andno operating systems switches.

Reference pixels remain local. JPO images without individual photographic attribution are local study only;public-domain drawing andAhunt photograph retain their source records. No photographic textures orweapons ship.

instrumentReview.checks: 18 shared imported-instrument tests and targeted F-35A geometry test passed at final source hash;cardinal heading regression covers15models. Swept hinges stay fixed andflaperon flap/roll mixes agree with imported transforms.
